reply_text:
Nadia, I found four tickets on Vantorre Group (the parent) across the pod channel, the Hartford war room and Moss's Strategic digests. I left Mobility out.

| Ticket | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **#8841** | Gate and kiosk issues at Allentown. In the pod channel Gideon says he closed it with support on Jul 1 (Detention Summary report, kiosk tablets). | #strategic-pod, Jul 1 |
| **#8841** (as #PD-8841) | Two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown, Gate 4, 2nd shift. | Moss digest, 4/27 |
| **#8841** | Gate kiosk timeout at Allentown, Dock Door 12, 2nd shift. Listed as still open. | Moss digest, 5/4 |
| **#8841** | Mateo reports drivers can't select Dock Door 14 on the kiosk at Newark, 2nd shift. Escalated to platform engineering. | Moss digest, 9/30 |
| **INC-4821** | Hartford kiosk outage. Gideon attached the status-page access screenshot to it. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 |
| **VT-55120** | Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. It holds Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 |
| **#PD-4418** | `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export dropping timestamps for Dock Door 9 at the 04:00 shift changeover. | Moss digest, 9/15/2025 |

Things to check before this goes to Mateo:
- **#8841 has conflicting details.** It is described as closed on Jul 1, open on May 4 and open again on Sep 30. The plant and door also change between Allentown and Newark, and between Doors 12 and 14. It may be reused or recurring, or the sources may be inconsistent. Confirm the history in the support system.
- **#PD-4418 is a likely match, not a certain one.** The digest only says "the account Nadia runs" and never names Vantorre. I included it because that is how the digests refer to her Vantorre Group account.
- **Hartford is Vantorre Group's plant.** Both Hartford tickets sit under the parent, but the channel never uses the account name.
- **Excluded tickets.** #4812 (3/10/2025 digest) is Vantorre Mobility, and #PD-4402 (9/15/2025 digest) is Quillfeather.
- **Digests that mention Vantorre Group without a ticket.** These are 3/10/2025, 7/7/2025, 5/3/2026 and 8/3/2026. The 8/3 digest covers Hartford but cites no ticket number.
- **Limits of this list.** I only read what is in those three places. The support system itself may hold more tickets.
